view.title: View
view.description: List: the next events, day by day. Week: this week, Monday to Sunday. Month: this month as a grid, events over several days as bars. Want two views? Add the module twice.

max_events.title: Max Events
max_events.description: Maximum number of upcoming events to display (list view).

maximum_days.title: Lookahead Days
maximum_days.description: How many days in the future to search for upcoming events (list view).

show_header.title: Show Header
show_header.description: Show or hide the module's header/title.

url.title: ICS URL
url.description: HTTP URL to the public or private .ics file.

color.title: Indicator Color
color.description: Hex color code or CSS custom property for event indicators (e.g., #ffffff, var(--color-ice-blue)).

icon.title: Lucide Icon
icon.description: Lucide outline icon name to show next to events (e.g., calendar, music, alert-circle).

interval.title: Update Interval (Seconds)
interval.description: Time to wait between calendar feed updates (e.g., 300 seconds = 5 minutes).
